title: E07-v1 renewal stage: donor copies (an inheritance route) with an isolated threshold-finding set, on cue-written discs
status: Registered by the lead on main, 13 November 2026, after the advisor's review of revision 1 and before any engine run (user approval of option (c): 13 November). No engine run has been made.
user_decision: option (c), 13 November 2026: donor copies as the main route, plus isolated newcomers with fast junction formation as a boundary set

decisions.D133: E07-v1's first choices (isolated newcomers at their own steady state)
decisions.D139: 'inherit' excluded; donor copies are an inheritance route, labelled as such
decisions.D144: validation drivers and protocols hold the experiment's choices; no engine change
decisions.D147: the sheets have no free field offsets; definitions are built through validation/tissue/field_solver_choice.declare() (auto: version 2)
decisions.composite_v2_decision_4: settled for donor copies in docs/E07_V1_DESIGN.md section 2: the slot's declared impermeant content, which equals the donor's in these worlds

engine_model: resolved_pump_replacement@1 (resolved_pump_composite@1 with scheduled_cell_replacement@1 over resolved_pump_tissue@3; junction formation delayed_first_order_junction_formation@1)

drivers.engine_runs: to be written after registration, reusing validation/tissue/heredity_turnover_literature.py's Stepper and run_segments; the arm process ends after writing records, checkpoint and result, and the analysis (outcome, opportunity, junction weight, run class) runs as its own process

world.sheet: heredity_pilot.long_sheet_definition's 127-cell held-bath sheet without its cue populations (availability 0 after the cue): E07 voltage-gated junctions at coupling scale s, homogeneous heredity cells, ionic background
world.discs: the five that held 70 min without turnover in sheet70: 37 cells at s 1.0, 0.6 and 0.3; 19 cells at s 0.6 and 0.3
world.start: sheet70's state at 120 s (2 min after the cue), declared as the initial state; every ledger starts at zero; time 0 is sheet70's 120 s
world.volume: fixed (replacement over water waits for composite v2 section 2)

judged_window.rule: every arm is judged at or before 4080 s (70 min after the cue), the end of the no-turnover control (sheet70)
judged_window.fast_k1_b_c: the second turnover's completion (41 min after the cue)
judged_window.central_k1: the control's end, 70 min after the cue (1.7 turnovers)
judged_window.fast_k3: the first turnover's completion (53 min after the cue); run on to 70 min after the cue, the rest reported and not judged
judged_window.central_choice: judged at 70 min rather than a new no-turnover run to 87 min: sheet70 covers the window; no run can reach the censor by then (loading of about 12% at most); every founder is replaced by 42 min after the cue and about 70% of the second turnover is done; about 26 min of wall time less per run. The cost: no complete second turnover in the central arms

numerics.dt_basis: the pre-screen's check (5 ms against 1 ms within 9 uV and 2.3e-6 in amounts, identical D sets); outside G2-Q1's 1 ms scope, hence the gate E1 on the worst case
numerics.checks: the model's checked_step and device row checks on every accepted row

execution.units: scripts/run_detached.sh, MemoryMax 6G each; the analysis out of process
execution.concurrency: at most two E07 units at once, and one while the L4 gap's 8G dispatch test is scheduled (cells.slice cap 15G)
execution.source: one clean snapshot of main taken after the S3 ledger fix (d020c3b) has landed, with the engine-run driver; E1 and every judged arm run from it
execution.hardware: CPU, one world per process, one thread

replacement.order: oldest first: a seeded permutation orders the founders; each slot is then replaced every R, events at (j + 1/2) R / N on the dt grid (every 8.0 s at fast k1 over the whole sheet)

donor_rule.a: a junction neighbour of the slot, drawn uniformly and blind to its state
donor_rule.b: none: the isolated H template (the sheet's declared H state)
donor_rule.c: a disc neighbour of the slot, drawn uniformly (control)

replacement.seeds: replicate r: permutation from numpy default_rng([20261113, 0, r]); donors, one per event in event order, from default_rng([20261113, 1, r])
replacement.newcomer_content: donor copies: the donor's amounts of every species and channel gates (by law) at the event time; the slot's routes, volume and fixed-charge background; junctions restart the formation law (A0 0, law_open); no junction state is carried (D139). The driver checks every donor's P equals the slot's declared P
replacement.residence: R = k (lag + tau): 1020 s (fast k1), 2400 s (central k1), 3060 s (fast k3); (b) R 1020 s

fast.basis: the division-born fast arm (Boassa 2010; design note G2 section 1.2), the literature ranges' lower ends

threshold_finding.label: threshold-finding: below the literature's 15-60 min; the 40 s point was seen only after the pre-screen's predictions were frozen; it tests no literature value; one seed, so tau* is a single draw

formation.abundance_under_turnover: the law's time-averaged A from each run's schedule (null-v3.json): fast k1 0.42-0.43 in the first turnover and 0.20 after it; central k1 0.39 and 0.15; fast k3 0.61-0.62 in its first turnover; (b) tau 40, 120, 300 s 0.92, 0.79, 0.62 and 0.91, 0.76, 0.52; (c) 0.42 and 0.20 inside the disc. At k1 the nominal s overstates the coupling about fivefold

stop_rules: all H: one minute after the first of two consecutive 10 s records with no D cell anywhere in the sheet (absorbing)
censor: the first record with osmotic excess above 15% against the H start in any cell; the run is judged at its last valid record and never dropped
refusal: a step the model refuses, or a failed device check on any row

null.definition: labels copied along each run's own schedule and donor draws; a newcomer takes its donor's label at the event time (read before any event at that time), or H when isolated; records every 10 s, each before any event at its own time
null.checked: on the pre-screen's own events, identical to the engine's J series at every record wherever the engine lost no D carrier and converted no newcomer

analysis.unit: the run: copies within a run are not independent (collective falls); nothing is pooled per copy

run_readouts.delta_J: J_engine - J_null at the judged record, on the same draws
run_readouts.D_loss: D copies that fell to H before their own replacement, over the D copies arrived (to the judged record)
run_readouts.recruitment: H copies converted to D, over the H copies arrived

run_class.erosion: (dJ < -delta or D-loss > 5%) and not the recruitment condition
run_class.recruitment: (dJ > +delta or recruitment > 5%) and not the erosion condition
run_class.mixed: both the erosion and the recruitment conditions

analysis.group_rule: per arm group (fast k1, central k1, fast k3) and s, pooling its discs: a class holds when at least two thirds of the runs are in it (both runs for a group of two); otherwise the group is split at that s, every run is reported with its class, and no class is claimed
analysis.censored_runs: judged at the last valid record (the last 10 s record with osmotic excess at or below 15% in every cell) against the paired null at that record; never dropped; the truncation is reported
analysis.d_outside: expected under copying (null median 10-14 cells at most); reported against the paired null; never a stop, validity or prediction failure

carried_over.B1 as the criterion: reported beside the null's P(B1), not decisive

E1.name: numerics gate on the worst case, before any judged arm
segments: (a) fast k1, 37 cells, s 1.0, seed 1, the first 600 s (events every 8.0 s)
(b) tau 40 s, 37 cells, s 1.0, seed 1, the first 300 s
(b) tau 40 s, 37 cells, s 0.6, seed 1, the first 300 s
E1.criteria: heredity-turnover-literature-20261111-01/numerics/criteria.json: no refusal; identical D sets outside 1 s of a state change, every change within 1 s; |dVm| <= 1 mV outside those windows; amounts and osmotic excess within 1e-4
E1.outcome: pass: the arms run at 5 ms; fail: at 1 ms with the minimal set

E2.name: validity
criteria: no refusal and no failed device check in any judged run
every definition passes the driver's checks: P equality, D147 declare(), a layout equal to sheet70's
D outside the disc never counts against validity

E3.name: (a) the class of every run, and of each arm group at each s (analysis)

E4.name: (c) control: disc slots, disc donors
E4.criterion: J = 1 at every record, no D copy and no founder lost; any loss reported with its time and neighbourhood

E5.name: (b) threshold-finding (reported, no pass or fail)
E5.readouts: per tau and s: isolated newcomers converted, as a fraction of those arriving with five or more D neighbours; dJ against the null; tau*, the largest ladder tau with at least one converted interior newcomer, a single draw

E6.name: junction weight per run (reported, qualifying E3-E5)
E6.readouts: every junction's abundance A and weight A x gate, time-averaged to the judged record and by junction class (D-D, D-H, H-H at each record), beside the law's A from the schedule; a neutral run with mean weight well below the nominal is read as neutral at low effective coupling

B1.name: J >= 0.8 through two turnovers
B1.role: reported for the fast k1, (b) and (c) runs beside the null's P(B1); not decisive (copying alone: 0 of 2000 seeds in (a))

bases: the stress segment N2 (seen after the pre-screen's predictions were frozen)
this null and the law's junction abundance (null-v3.json)

E3.fast_k1_s0.3: neutral in all 4 runs; dJ = 0 at every record in at least 3
E3.fast_k1_s0.6: neutral holds (at least 6 of 8 runs), at low effective coupling
E3.fast_k1_s1.0: erosion holds (at least 6 of 8): dJ from -0.35 to -0.05, D-loss 5-25%; all H in at most 2 runs
E3.central_k1: erosion in both runs at s 1.0; neutral in both at s 0.6
E3.fast_k3_s1.0: erosion in all 3 runs, stronger than at k1: dJ after the first turnover from -0.6 to -0.1; all H by 70 min after the cue in at least 1
E3.fast_k3_s0.6: erosion holds (at least 2 of 3): dJ from -0.4 to -0.05
E3.recruitment: no H copy converts in any (a) run

E4.s1.0: J >= 0.9 after the second turnover, no collective loss (low confidence)

E5.s0.6: recruitment falls with tau: >= 40% of interior newcomers arriving with five or more D neighbours at 40 s, >= 20% at 120 s, <= 20% at 300 s; tau* >= 120 s (a single draw)
E5.s1.0: all H within the first turnover at every tau; recruitment, if any, only at 40 s and early

predictions.E6: mean weight after the first turnover about A on D-D and H-H junctions and about 0.1 A on D-H junctions (gate near its minimum), with A as the law gives (0.20 fast k1, 0.15 central k1; about 0.6 in fast k3's first turnover)
predictions.validity: no refusal, no failed device check, no censor; at most about 12.5% excess by 70 min after the cue
predictions.B1: fails in every fast k1 and (b) run; passes in (c) at s 0.6

budget.cost: 7.7 ms per step with two units (5.8 ms with one): a 39-min run about 60 min, a 68-min run about 105 min of wall time; E1 about 3.1 core-hours; analyses about 1
budget.proposed: 38 judged runs plus E1, about 50 core-hours: about 25 h on two units
budget.minimal: fast k1: 4 seeds at s 1.0, 2 per disc at s 0.6, 1 per disc at s 0.3; central 1 each; fast k3 2 each; (b) at s 0.6 only; (c); E1: about 29 core-hours, about 14.5 h
budget.fuller: the proposed set plus 16 fast k1 runs (8 at s 1.0, 4 per disc at s 0.6): about 66 core-hours

exclusions: water and volume (composite v2 section 2, held until S3's fix and first round land)
k10 and second turnovers of k3 (beyond the control and the fixed-volume budget)
the full 825-node tissue (needs GH200 or a long-time method)
heterogeneous worlds and per-newcomer parameter draws
literature-range formation for isolated newcomers (the pre-screen's 13 arms: none of 317 converted); not rerun
order: 1 design, null and this PROPOSED protocol on the agent's branch
2 review by the lead and the advisor; registration by the lead on main
3 the engine-run driver (validation only; analysis out of process) and a dry run on non-registered seeds (r >= 101), development
4 after d020c3b lands: one clean snapshot of main with the driver; E1 from it
5 the judged arms, once, from the same snapshot
lead_decisions_taken: Revision 2 is registered as drafted: central arms judged at the control's end (4080 s), censored runs judged at their last valid record against the paired null and never dropped, the run as the unit of analysis with the two-thirds rule per arm group and s, fast k3 arms at s 1.0 and 0.6, E6 junction weight per run, and 'no D outside the disc' dropped.
Execution: one clean snapshot of main taken after the S3 ledger fix (d020c3b) and the E07-v1 engine-run driver have landed; E1 and every judged arm run from it, in the protocol's order.
Units: at most two at once on CPUs 2 and 3, each capped at 6G with the analysis out of process, and one at a time while an 8G L4 test is scheduled.
